name: Jason Crow
bio: a Representative from Colorado; born in Madison, Dane County, Wis., March 15, 1979; B.A., University of Wisconsin, Madison, Wis., 2002; J.D., University of Denver, Denver, Colo., 2009; United States Army, 2002-2006; adjunct professor; lawyer; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-present); one of the managers appointed by the House of Representatives in 2020 to conduct the impeachment proceedings of Donald J. Trump, President of the United States.
